## RESUME BLOCK — intercity endpoint walk recall fixed, PR #198 open (2026-11-18 17:55 EET)

- Root cause of most empty intercity corridors was a hardcoded 5 km access/egress walking cap, not missing data: oblast centres sit 3–9 km from their railway station (Запоріжжя 9.1 km, Вінниця 6.4 km). The timetable layer also rejected any radius above 10 km with a `TypeError`, surfacing `GTFS-пошук тимчасово недоступний`.
- Fix (branch `fix/intercity-endpoint-walk-recall`, PR https://github.com/dima1203oleg/MarshGO-Server/pull/198): 15 km intercity endpoint budget at all four `server/index.ts` sites; `MAX_ENDPOINT_WALKING_METERS` validation bound; walk-shed bounded by candidate count (`MAX_ENDPOINT_CANDIDATE_STOPS = 300`) instead of shrinking the radius; only the trailing last-mile walk may spill past the journey horizon (`MAX_EGRESS_SPILL_SECONDS`).
- Evidence on canonical Server `:3003`: national 27×27 API matrix 107/702 → 117/702 pairs with routes (15.2% → 16.7%), 0 errors. `Запоріжжя↔Київ` 0 → 12/7, `Київ→Чернівці` 0 → 7, `Львів→Чернівці` 0 → 5, `Запоріжжя↔Дніпро` 0 → 2. The 5 pairs lost by an intermediate 3 km cap are restored (`Полтава↔Одеса`, `Кропивницький↔Полтава`). Warm latency better than baseline (`Київ→Львів` 24 s → 8 s, `Київ→Тернопіль` 23 s → 3.5 s, median 721 ms → 607 ms).
- `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `tests/gtfs-timetable.test.ts` 84/84 (was 81, +3 regression tests); `tests/journey-search.test.ts` 6/6.
- Still data-blocked, not code-blocked: Житомир, Миколаїв, Херсон, Черкаси, Чернігів, Краматорськ have no railway stop in the ODbL feed (167 stops nationwide) and no static GTFS registered in `mobility_providers`; Kyiv metro stays disabled because `gisserver.kyivcity.gov.ua` is unreachable. Do not fabricate routes for these.
- Do not overwrite the unrelated dirty `server/routing/osrm*.ts` files in `MarshGO-Server` — they belong to another task and were left unstaged.
- Production remains `NOT_RELEASED`.
